pitch_hooks.name: outofstate_convenience
pitch_hooks.angle: Distance is the pain; we handle 100% remotely
pitch_hooks.lead_line: Managing a Memphis property from Albuquerque NM is its own kind of work — tax notices, code letters, occasional weed-cutting bills. We handle the full close-out by mail and wire. You don't fly in.

pitch_hooks.name: investor_to_investor
pitch_hooks.lead_line: Saw the LLC in title. We're investor-to-investor — no agent commission, fast assignment-friendly close, RESPA-clean Memphis title. Happy to package this with any other Memphis lots if you're looking to thin inventory.
pitch_hooks.use_when: LLC / corporate owner, vacant lot or low-yield SFR.

pitch_hooks.name: ministry_clean_close
pitch_hooks.angle: Ministries hold real estate that's not central to the mission
pitch_hooks.lead_line: Ministries sometimes end up holding lots that aren't central to the mission. We can close clean and quick, freeing the funds for ministry work. Cash, no commission, 14-day close.

pitch_hooks.name: back_tax_relief
pitch_hooks.angle: We pay the back tax — you walk clean
pitch_hooks.lead_line: We see the property's been on the back-tax list for a few years. We pay every dollar of back tax + penalty at closing — out of OUR side, not yours. You walk away clean.
pitch_hooks.use_when: TS2202 lead. Strong on absentee owners with no plan to develop.

pitch_hooks.name: vacant_lot_quick_cash
pitch_hooks.angle: Lots are inert assets; we move fast
pitch_hooks.lead_line: Vacant lots aren't easy to sell — agents don't want them, builders take months. We'll wire cash for 1537  WILSON ST in 14 days. No fix-up. No inspection. As-is.
